items.title: Nvidia, Meta, Revolution Medicines, Abercrombie, Intuit, Salesforce, Moderna, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks traded modestly lower Wednesday ahead of Nvidia’s earnings report and after the personal consumption expenditures index, or PCE, for July revealed inflation was a bit stronger than expected.  Nvidia   earnings after the bell could be key in determining where the artificial-intelligence trade goes next.  Intel  slipped 0.1% and  Broadcom  declined 0.9% with investors in wait-and-see mode when it comes to chip stocks.
